sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite atlas for a softly hand-painted travel jigsaw. Five independently painted watercolor/gouache cutouts, TRUE transparent RGBA with empty alpha between subjects. Landscape1536x1024, three columns/two rows, bottom-right cell completely empty. Very wide transparent gutters, each COMPLETE subject centered inside own cell, maxheight400, no touching borders or crossing cells. Do not paint background/halo/grid/checkerboard/stickers/text. Natural subtly textured paint, gentle upper-left daylight, no hard outlines. Subjects in cell order: An apple orchard gate in warm terracotta earth: TOP LEFT small apple-leaf twig with three leaves, bottom stem; TOP MIDDLE different olive-leaf twig on thin bottom stem; TOP RIGHT slender ivory cosmos flower on long green bottom stem; BOTTOM LEFT little rooted golden grass tuft; BOTTOM MIDDLE small horizontal white cloud with faint peach edges. No scenery or backdrop.
